659:t_235:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do it! I won't let something this gloomy swallow the world where $$ティファ$$ and I live!」

659:t_236:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If we leave a creature like this alone, even Earth will be swallowed up!」

659:t_236:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Exactly! We devour everything!」

659:t_236:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour you, devour all life, and in time devour everything in the universe!」

659:t_236:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You people...! Do you think you're the only ones living in this universe!?」

659:t_236:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We have no choice! We fight to live, too!」

659:t_237:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「I can feel it... This one is the vanguard of Earth humanity's evolution!」

659:t_237:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「If we devour this one, we too will reach the truth and see the path to $$シンカ$$!」

659:t_237:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
(From evolution to $$シンカ$$... Watching these things, I'm starting to understand what that means...)

659:t_237:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's exactly why I can't let a creature that's a lump of ego like this wipe out humanity...! We stop them here!)

659:t_238:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Creatures that do nothing but take lives for their own desires...! There's no place for you in this universe!」

659:t_238:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「I have no intention of begging forgiveness from the likes of you!」

659:t_238:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are the emissaries of the Great Void! In time, we will be the ones who decide everything in this universe!」

659:t_238:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If this swollen ego is going to destroy everything in the universe...!」

659:t_238:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then I'll stop it here! So that the universe can be filled with life!」

659:t_239:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Taking a life means taking away evolution, possibility, everything! Why can't you understand that!?」

659:t_239:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「There is nothing to worry about. We will evolve in your place.」

659:t_239:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We alone are enough to live in this universe. Yes... we are the one and only absolute existence!」

659:t_239:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't hand possibility over to guys like this!」

659:t_239:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We will live... We'll make sure we survive! To see where humanity's inner possibility leads, too!」

659:t_240:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「You who have abandoned understanding one another are the enemy of every life in this universe!」

659:t_240:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Don't think you can absorb us like the writhing metal!」

659:t_240:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are absolute beings! Other life is meaningless before our will!」

659:t_240:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「So this is $$バアル$$... An enemy that refuses to understand us...」

659:t_240:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then I won't hesitate! Fighting enemies like you is my new mission!」

659:t_241:0.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to take lives that badly... If you want a fight, I'll be your opponent!」

659:t_241:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Ignorant brat. Don't think the likes of you can be a match for us.」

659:t_241:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But your power interests us. Come, become one with us!」

659:t_241:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I will never become a being like you! Someone who spreads war and feels no pain at all even when it makes others miserable!」

659:t_241:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's go! I won't let you, who only spread the fighting, do as you please with this universe!」

659:t_242:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... we fight to protect life!」

659:t_242:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You will learn that it is meaningless.」

659:t_242:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour all life. And then we will become the one and only absolute existence.」

659:t_242:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「If words can't reach you anymore... I won't hesitate to fight!」

659:t_242:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「If you say you won't accept other life, then I'll fight, and I'll stop you!」

659:t_243:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「You who block the path to the future of humanity... no, of all life: $$バアル$$!」

659:t_243:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That is not so. We are saying that we will give you a future.」

659:t_243:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「It will be accomplished by becoming one with us. There is nothing to fear.」

659:t_243:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「What you're trying to do is nothing but painting over our future with your own self-serving logic!」

659:t_243:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I can't accept your existence! Fighting you is my mission!」

659:t_244:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Even here, someone ignorant of their place stands up to us.」

659:t_244:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「How pitiful. That is what a soldier who only follows orders is!」

659:t_244:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fighting you is not an assignment. It is the mission of the living.」

659:t_244:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed...! Objective: giant $$インベーダー#pilot$$!」

659:t_245:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no mercy to spare for a villain who declared a massacre!」

659:t_245:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「No matter how huge the opponent is, I'll clear it out fast!」

659:t_245:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This man...! Facing our grandeur, does he feel no fear at all!?」

659:t_245:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You fool...! Do you not understand the situation!?」

659:t_245:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't be called a fool by a stupid pest!」

659:t_245:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can already see the path to victory! All that's left is to carry it out!」

659:t_246:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The truth... $$シンカ$$... Did they seek that, and let their egos swell to this extent...?)

659:t_246:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But if we don't reach it too, we may not be able to fight them...!)

659:t_246:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You seem to be speechless before us.」

659:t_246:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「No wonder. That is the natural human reaction.」

659:t_246:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Nothing but oversized insects...! It's too early to think you've won just because you got the power of this 'Great Void' or whatever!」

659:t_246:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've already established a tactic to break out of this situation! Know that you have no chance of winning!」

659:t_247:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Found you, $$異能生存体$$!」

659:t_247:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That existence that transcends causality... we'll make it our power!」

659:t_247:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
(You too are pitiful beings possessed by fighting.)

659:t_247:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But I can't hand my life over to you.)

659:t_248:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know if it's the Great Void or $$シンカ$$ or whatever, but it looks like you don't get the basic rule of society, that you don't cause trouble for other people...!」

659:t_248:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You, $$始原の特異点$$! Those are not words for you to say, you who committed the greatest taboo!」

659:t_248:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But we are grateful. Because you destroyed the wall called spacetime, we can even obtain everything!」

659:t_248:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So it's my fault these guys are running wild, too, huh...」

659:t_248:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't worry, $$モーム$$. I'm used to villains like this shoving the blame on me by now.」

659:t_248:6.en:
$$桂$$
「But I'll settle the score! Let's hurry up and slam in every round we've got!」

659:t_249:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「$$スフィア$$! If only that power were ours!」

659:t_249:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We could make everything in this universe ours!」

659:t_249:2.en:
$n
「I can't hand my $$いがみ合う双子$$ over to guys like this!」

659:t_249:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You are our enemy... no, the enemy of everything that lives!」

659:t_249:4.en:
$n
「We're alive! I'll show you that power breaking even your Great Void!」
